points.description: set global positions defined to identify the object

envelope.description: a rectangle indicating the influence/spen of the object

mode.description:
defines  what the points represent
If mode is 'Points',  we plot them as points.
If mode is 'Polyline', we draw a path using this points in order.
If mode is 'Polygon', we draw a path using this points in order, looping back at the end.
